verdict.rationale:
Aider exposes a scripting/Python API (`Coder.create`/`coder.run`) and a `--message` CLI mode for programmatic single-instruction execution, but this is far narrower than the interactive chat/browser UI, which offers many features (e.g. /architect, /voice, /web, /map, /test, /run, /model, watch-files) not exposed through the scripting API. No REST/OpenAPI surface exists (confirmed 404s), so API parity with the UI is only partial.

missing for 10: programmatic access to slash-commands like /architect, /voice, /web, /map, /test, /run via the scripting API; a documented REST/OpenAPI interface; independent confirmation of API-UI feature parity.
